baselines.name: Overall historical count expectation
baselines.definition: Arithmetic mean of four-week Lyme target counts across all rows in the fold training split
baselines.availability: Only training targets with target_window_end strictly before validation_start

baselines.name: Municipality historical count expectation
baselines.definition: Arithmetic mean of four-week Lyme target counts for the validation row municipality
baselines.availability: Only same-municipality training targets with target_window_end strictly before validation_start; fallback is baseline A

baselines.name: Seasonal historical count expectation
baselines.definition: Arithmetic mean of four-week Lyme target counts for the validation issue week's canonical ISO week
baselines.availability: Only same-ISO-week training targets with target_window_end strictly before validation_start; fallback is baseline A

baselines.name: Municipality and seasonal historical count expectation
baselines.definition: Arithmetic mean of four-week Lyme target counts for the municipality and canonical ISO week combination
baselines.availability: Only same-municipality and same-ISO-week training targets with target_window_end strictly before validation_start; fallback order is municipality, seasonal, overall

baselines.name: Previous four completed weeks persistence
baselines.definition: Sum of canonical observed Lyme cases at exactly t-4, t-3, t-2 and t-1
baselines.availability: Uses only municipality-specific completed weeks strictly before issue_week t; issue week t and every future week are excluded
